caption: Agentic CLI
name: agentic_cli
description: Agent Journal's Agentic CLI extension prototype. Uses ACP's session, prompt turn, content block, tool call and permission vocabulary within OCSF. The uid 901 is a PROVISIONAL, UNREGISTERED prototype assignment: it is not reserved in the OCSF extensions registry and must not be used for a release package. Packages written against it pin this uid, this version and the compiled schema hash in run.json; readers resolve class names through that pin and refuse a mismatched assignment. Version 0.2.0-prototype moves invariant per-run facts (cli_agent, producer, capture time, contract and artifact hashes) to run.json: events reference them through journal.run_uid, journal.contract_uid and source_ref.artifact. attribution.method_id states whether candidates came from a source-reported identifier or a declared derivation rule. Version 0.3.0-prototype adds the session_context class (settings reported, context injected, accounting reported), the session_settings object, the Turn started activity of prompt_turn, the Incomplete-at-source-end parse status for a record cut off by the end of its source, and the settings/context attributes those use. Packages written incrementally by the Java writer pin this version. Version 0.4.0-prototype (FND-1, Owner decision 2026-10-22) makes cli_agent this extension's own object: it no longer extends the core ai_agent (no inherited ai_model, charter, uid_numeric or framework type enum); it declares name, version, uid, instance_uid and product. Version 0.5.0-prototype (SEM-1 candidate, 2026-10-22; its new meanings await the Project Owner's semantic approval) records the mapping rule as journal.rule_uid instead of in OCSF unmapped; adds identity_basis_id on tool_call and operation (a stream-local item identifier is not a model-facing call identifier), tool_namespace (for example an MCP server), command_line on operation (the reported command string, never parsed into argv), measurement_status_id on usage_observation (measured versus possibly the source's default) and reasoning_form_id on content_block (full reasoning versus a summary); an operation may be a standalone observation without a wrapping tool call. Version 0.6.0-prototype (SEM-CLOSE, the delegated semantic decisions of 2026-10-22; its changed meanings await the managing reviewer's binding) exposes usage in disjoint economic tranches: uncached_input_tokens replaces input_tokens (whose meaning followed each vendor), cache reads and writes are disjoint, cache_write_tiers breaks writes down, reasoning_relation_id states whether reasoning is part of output, aggregation_id (scope total or cumulative snapshot) is a facet beside scope and finality, and components[] states per component whether it was reported, derived by a declared rule or is unavailable. model_response.response_uid is optional and is only the provider's response identifier; a source-local content item is item_uid with its identity_basis_id, and activity 3 Item completed observes it without naming a response. tool_call gains activity 4 Started (an invocation the source reports as started, not the model's request) and tool_family (the source's item type, not a tool name). reasoning_form_id gains 3 Redacted. Version 0.7.0-prototype (Tier 1 foundation wave, 2026-10-22; candidate for the managing reviewer) adds measurement_status_id on usage_component: what the source establishes about each component's quantity (Measured, Possibly default, or 3 Conditional for a component derived from a possibly default operand), apart from how Journal obtained it; a Codex zero that the pinned emitter also writes when the provider omits the member is Possibly default even inside non-zero usage.
